### Step 1: Master Programming Basics

To begin, you need a strong foundation in programming, with a focus on Python and R, the most widely used languages in NLP. Python, in particular, has numerous libraries like NLTK, spaCy, and TextBlob, which are specifically designed to work with text data. Learn how to manipulate strings, work with data structures, and perform basic text processing tasks.

Once you’re comfortable with programming, it’s time to dive deeper into NLP fundamentals.
